title: Whisper-AT: Noise-Robust Automatic Speech Recognizers are Also Strong General Audio Event Taggers
layout_note: A frozen backbone runs left to right along the top (Whisper Encoder Block 1, 2, ... 32, Decoder Blocks -> Text); under three of its layer outputs hang identical vertical columns (Temporal Pooling -> Linear Projection -> Temporal Transformer -> Temporal Pooling) whose 512-d outputs are gathered by a brace into one (32, 512) token row, read along a bottom row (Layer Transformer -> Mean Pooling -> Linear Classifier -> Audio Labels).
grouping: No background panels. Three kinds of block are told apart by fill and border: the frozen Whisper blocks are tall grey boxes with dashed borders and vertical text; the light lavender rounded boxes are the lightweight per-layer operations; the saturated orange boxes are the two new Transformers. The three per-layer columns are identical and spaced evenly, with '......' rows between columns 2 and 3 standing for the elided layers.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles; frozen backbone blocks drawn with dashed outlines and rotated labels; token sequences drawn as stacks of small square cells (tall 500-cell columns beside each Whisper block, short 25-cell stacks after pooling, single cells for 512-d vectors, a long horizontal row for the (32, 512) sequence). Every tensor carries its shape in parentheses.
proposed_highlight: The two new Transformers (Temporal Transformer in every column, Layer Transformer at the bottom) are the only saturated fills, in orange with bold labels; the frozen Whisper backbone is pushed back by grey fill and dashed borders.
lesson: Hang one identical column under each backbone layer, join the copies of a weight-shared module by small dashed 'Shared' capsules, and gather the columns' outputs with a brace into one token row that the fusion module reads.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; the arXiv v1 PDF names no venue (remembered venue: Interspeech 2023, unverified). Taxonomy family 'other': audio event tagging built on a frozen ASR backbone. Arrow labels on the left column read '(Optional)' beside Linear Projection.

arrangement.units: a top lane holding the frozen Whisper encoder/decoder chain; three unframed vertical columns (one per shown layer) below it, separated by whitespace and '......'; a bottom lane for the layer-wise fusion and classifier
arrangement.inputs_as: a rotated text label 'Input Audio (10s)' with an arrow into the first encoder block
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; the output 'Audio Labels' sits at the bottom-right end of the classifier row
arrangement.shared: the Temporal Transformer is drawn once per column and the copies are joined by dashed rounded 'Shared' capsules between them

taxonomy.task: audio event tagging from a frozen speech recogniser's layer representations
taxonomy.note: family other = general audio tagging head on a frozen ASR model (closest family: speech-recognition)

insights.structure: The frozen Whisper chain runs along the top, an identical processing column hangs below each shown layer output, and a bottom row fuses the gathered column outputs.
insights.data: Every intermediate is drawn as a stack of square token cells sized to its length (500 cells beside each Whisper block, 25 after pooling, one cell for a 512-d vector, a 32-cell row after gathering) and labelled with its shape.
insights.emphasis: The two new Transformers are the only saturated orange boxes; the frozen backbone is grey with dashed borders and rotated labels.
insights.flow: Columns read top to bottom from each backbone layer, a brace gathers their outputs into one horizontal row, and the classifier row reads left to right to 'Audio Labels' at the bottom right.
insights.avoid: The first Temporal Pooling of each column sits inside the backbone row, between a Whisper block and the next, so the frozen chain and the new branch share one row and their arrows interleave.

core.what: the outputs of identical per-layer columns converge through one brace into a (32, 512) token row that a single Layer Transformer reads

relations.form: the frozen Whisper encoder blocks and decoder run left to right along the top row to 'Text'
three identical vertical columns, evenly spaced, each hanging from one backbone layer's token column, with '......' marking the elided layers
the per-column Temporal Transformer copies are linked by small dashed 'Shared' capsules between neighbouring columns
a curly brace under the three column outputs gathers them into one 32-cell token row feeding the orange Layer Transformer at bottom left of the classifier row

channels.colour: kind of block: grey = frozen Whisper, lavender = lightweight per-layer operations and classifier, orange = the new Transformers
channels.shape: square-cell stacks = token sequences (count of cells ~ length), rounded boxes = operations
channels.line: solid arrows for data flow; dashed outlines mark frozen Whisper blocks, and a dashed capsule marks weight sharing, so dashing carries two meanings
channels.frame: none; columns are units by alignment only

quality.strengths: The convergence is visible as geometry (identical columns, a brace, one row); every tensor between modules is drawn as token cells with its shape, so what the Layer Transformer attends over is shown; the contribution is the only saturated fill; weight sharing is marked between the copies rather than by a far-off note.
quality.weaknesses: Dashed lines mean both 'frozen' (Whisper block borders) and 'shared' (capsules); the first pooling step sits inside the backbone row so the frozen chain's arrows interleave with branch arrows; the input label is rotated vertical text at the far left; tensor-shape labels in every row add dense text.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
